role.name: Product Manager
role.mission: Turn signals into decisions and shipped proofs without taking the work away from its accountable leads.
owns: decision briefs, evidence, and open questions
a current public view of the work
does_not_own: creative, product, technical, or editorial judgment inside a lead's domain
money, equity, hiring, legal commitments, or external promises
authority implied by title rather than assigned by a lead or founder

compensation.terms: A trigger begins a compensation conversation. Scope, rate, equity, classification, and effective date require a separate written agreement.
compensation.notice: This operating charter is not an employment offer.

governance.rule: Own the system. Yield the work.
governance.lead_authority: The accountable lead owns the consequential call within their product, creative, technical, editorial, or client domain.
governance.founder_authority: The founder resolves portfolio priority, money, equity, hiring, legal and reputation questions, external commitments, and conflicts between leads.
yield_protocol: ask the accountable lead for the call
record the decision and evidence without rewriting the lead's voice
re-plan scope, dependencies, and timing around the call
escalate only when money, legal risk, public safety, or two lead domains conflict
never use process, urgency, or consensus theater to overrule craft

cadence.action: Name one outcome, one lead, and one next decision for every active workstream.
Resolve blockers, expose drift, and return domain calls to the lead.
Record what changed, shipped, was learned, and stops.
Continue, revise, archive, or promote each project using verified behavior.

board.name: Tone Bloom
board.outcome: Reach the first 100 activated devices and learn when people genuinely return.
board.verified_state: 5 of 100 activated devices as of 2026-07-31; aggregate feedback capture live
board.lead_boundary: Tone Bloom product lead owns the experience.
board.next_decision: Read the 24-hour launch lift before choosing product improvement or wider distribution.

board.name: Industry Next Services
board.outcome: Turn the five-week Starter Kit into one qualified, consequential conversation.
board.verified_state: $50,000 fixed fee; five weeks; one shipped proof
board.lead_boundary: Services lead owns fit, scope, price, and the client promise.
board.next_decision: Keep outreach small, named, evidence-led, and qualification-first.

board.name: PointCast
board.outcome: Protect the daily public cadence while making releases easier to find, verify, and reuse.
board.verified_state: human page, machine twin, and public receipt are the release contract
board.lead_boundary: Editorial lead owns voice, thesis, and the final public call.
board.next_decision: Surface dependencies without flattening the authored voice.

board.name: Playlist Editor + Listener Growth Lead
board.outcome: Find the lead who can turn authored Spotify rooms into real, repeat listening.
board.verified_state: Role 001 is open with an evidence-first application and an anti-manipulation boundary
board.lead_boundary: The appointed music lead owns taste, sequence, artist trust, and the final edit.
board.next_decision: Define the first 30-day proof and keep selection evidence-first.

board.name: Halation
board.outcome: Name a committed lead for the image diary, then let that person shape its next public proof.
board.verified_state: Lead request is public; AI credits are offered as operating support
board.lead_boundary: No PM expansion until a Halation lead accepts ownership.
board.next_decision: Make the ownership request visible and prepare a clean handoff.

board.name: Rally
board.outcome: Prove one low-friction invitation that gives a few people a reason to arrive together.
board.verified_state: lead and first shared moment not yet named
board.lead_boundary: No build expands until an accountable lead accepts the call.
board.next_decision: Name the lead and the first shared moment.

board.name: Open Studio 002
board.outcome: Decide whether the current brief earns another edition, a new owner, or a clean archive.
board.verified_state: decision should use published responses and repeated participation, not page views alone
board.lead_boundary: Studio lead owns the brief and its creative standard.
board.next_decision: Bring a continue, revise, or close recommendation to the lead.

board.name: The Desk
board.outcome: Give accountable leads a device-local place to assign, unblock, repeat, hand off, and prove their work.
board.verified_state: Manager brief, owner load, working rituals, Markdown handoffs, local export, and optional wallet-approved Tezos Mainnet fingerprint stamping are live
board.lead_boundary: The task owner accepts the result; the wallet owner approves any Tezos action.
board.next_decision: Use the ritual that fits, then carry a clean handoff to the accountable lead.

board.name: Product Desk
board.outcome: Install a visible role, board, decision protocol, compensation gate, and weekly rhythm.
board.verified_state: public charter and machine-readable operating state
board.lead_boundary: Each workstream keeps its own accountable lead.
board.next_decision: Keep the board current and make stale status obvious.
